mainEntity.name: What is a crypto PR agency in Japan and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto PR agency for Japan handles outreach to Japanese-language crypto outlets including CryptoTimes JP, CoinPost and CoinDesk Japan, as well as coordinating with global tier-1 newsrooms when a Japan-market story warrants parallel coverage. It is for any crypto or Web3 project targeting Japanese retail investors, seeking a Japan exchange listing, or expanding into APAC. Shilika Jain runs Japan-market PR as part of a broader APAC localisation service, covering Korea and Japan together or individually.

mainEntity.name: How much does crypto PR in Japan cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator handling Japan-market placements alongside global strategy runs $5K–$12K/month. A full Japan-plus-Korea APAC launch sprint runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks. Full-service agencies commonly charge $15K–$45K/month for a multi-person team, most of whom have no direct relationships with Japanese newsrooms. The APAC scope is included in the core retainer, not billed as a regional add-on.

mainEntity.name: Which Japanese outlets can you actually get coverage in?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary Japan-market crypto outlets are CryptoTimes JP, CoinPost and CoinDesk Japan. Coverage in those three outlets, timed with a global CoinDesk or Cointelegraph story, is a credible Japan launch. For Korean parallel coverage the relevant outlets are BloomingBit and TokenPost. Coverage depends on a news hook with a Japan-relevant angle, not on distribution volume.

mainEntity.name: What does the process look like and how long does it take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Japan-market launch typically runs over four to six weeks: a market audit and narrative localisation in weeks one and two, embargo outreach to Japanese and global editors in weeks three and four, and a coordinated publication window in weeks five and six. Sustaining coverage after launch runs on a monthly retainer. The highest-leverage work starts six to eight weeks before your target announcement date, when there is still time to build the Japan-specific story frame properly.

Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your Japan-market press footprint and story angle, or book a 30-minute call to plot it live. No deck needed, no account-team intro call.
